title: Fix plan approval state indicators
summary: Fixed the macOS plan approval UI so stale requests do not show stale and approved/locked messages at the same time, and added a visible waiting badge to the menu-bar icon when one or more plans are pending.
userVisibleChange: Stale plan approvals now show only stale/disabled copy and no approve/reject actions; the menu-bar icon shows a visible waiting indicator while plans need review.

risks.title: Automated code-review agents timed out before returning findings
risks.mitigation: The diff was manually inspected and covered by focused Swift tests and Xcode build/test.

decisions.title: Scope notices to the request they came from
decisions.rationale: A global success notice could be displayed beside a different stale request, creating contradictory state.

decisions.title: Replace actions with terminal-state guidance for non-pending requests
decisions.rationale: Stale, locked, rejected, superseded, and fulfilled requests should not expose approve/reject controls.

decisions.title: Use a badged menu-bar icon for pending plans
decisions.rationale: The app needs to signal waiting work without requiring the user to open the menu first.

validation.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project EVEApproval.xcodeproj -scheme EVEApproval -configuration Release -destination platform=macOS build
